verdict.rationale: Jira documents automations, including Rovo AI-created custom automation rules. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for those automations. Product sandboxes are an adjacent feature for testing changes before production, not automation versioning or rollback. REST API versioning concerns the API itself, not users' automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
